title: Communion of Saints
definition: The Communion of Saints is the shared fellowship, mutual care, and spiritual participation believers have in Christ.
summary: Communion of Saints is the shared life, fellowship, and mutual participation believers have in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ unites His people into a fellowship of grace, love, prayer, and service.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The communion of saints is the shared spiritual fellowship of all believers in Christ. Scripture teaches that Christians share one Lord, one salvation, one Spirit, and mutual responsibility for one another.

This communion reaches beyond surface friendship. It includes shared burdens, shared joys, shared truth, shared mission, and shared hope.

Jesus creates this communion by uniting people to Himself. Because believers belong to Him, they belong to one another in holy fellowship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because loneliness and individualism can make Christians live disconnected lives. The communion of saints reminds believers that they are part of a redeemed family, not isolated survivors.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice fellowship that goes deeper than greetings. Share prayer, confession, encouragement, meals, service, and Scripture with other believers, and remember suffering members as your own family in Christ.
